snippet.title: The Alters: Last Variable | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist #TheAlters: #LastVariable now: https://re.11bits.com/001
Get Deluxe Edition with huge discount: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54533/The_Alters_Deluxe_Edition/

Jan Scientist awakens with everything he's built, discovered, and created at your disposal. Now, forge a team of specialized Alters and solve the enigma of the Oasis before time - and the sun - runs out.

#TheAlters: #LastVariable expansion launches July 13, 2026 on consoles and PC.
